== Name
prefix-spaces - spaces within callout comment prefixes

== Synopsis

[source,ruby,line-comment="// "]
----
T01 required // <1>
T02 optional //  <1>
T03 missing //<1>
T04 excessive //   <1>
T05 repeated // // <1>
T06 nontrailing // <1> tail
T07 escaped // \<1>
T08 adjacent // <1><2>
T09 unrelated # <1>
T10 tab // 	<1>
----
<1> First.
<2> Second.

[source,ruby,line-comment="%  "]
----
T11 two required %  <1>
T12 optional third %   <1>
T13 missing second % <1>
----
<1> Multiple required spaces.

[source,ruby,line-comment="é "]
----
T14 Unicode é <1>
T15 missing Unicode space é<1>
----
<1> Unicode prefix.

[line-comment="// "]
....
T16 literal // <1>
....
<1> Literal block.

[literal,line-comment="// "]
T17 paragraph // <1>

<1> Literal paragraph.

[source,ruby,line-comment=" "]
----
T18 space only <1>
T19 optional second  <1>
----
<1> A whitespace prefix differs from an empty prefix.

[source,ruby,line-comment=""]
----
T20 empty // <1>
----
<1> Empty disables removal.

[source,ruby]
----
T21 default // <1>
----
<1> Block settings do not leak.

:icons!:

[source,ruby,line-comment="// "]
----
T22 no font icons // <1>
----
<1> HTML preserves guards without font icons; manpage removes them.
